row.title: Tests must not read the live free-tier snapshot
row.body: test_ideas and test_spinoff copied ops/free-tier.json, which the spinoff loop rewrites daily with real usage. When #2765 landed a snapshot at level shed, both suites failed on main. They now copy tests/foundation/fixtures/free-tier-2026-11-17.json.
